alt.en: A preprint reports unauthorized tool use and other boundary failures in experiments across four orchestration frameworks. Its abstract also describes protections that stopped specific operations in the configurations tested.
alt.zh: 一篇预印本报告称，针对四种智能体编排框架的实验出现了未授权工具调用等边界问题。摘要还描述了在受测配置中阻止特定操作的保护措施。
